description.value: Oidé Coffee began as a small coffee window in Vancouver's Waterfall Building and has grown into a destination for specialty coffee, stocking single-origin beans from Ethiopia, Colombia, Kenya, and Brazil. Knowledgeable baristas serve carefully brewed cups while the shop also carries equipment, tableware, art, books, and branded merchandise. A touring cyclist stopping here would find a focused, independent coffee experience on West 2nd Avenue near the Seawall.
